gaps.description: auth.js password validation: test the bcrypt.compare() path against a stored hash. Current coverage is 76.1% statements; the login/validation logic is not exercised by tests.
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Login with correct password returns 200; login with wrong password returns 401; auth.js coverage ≥ 90%

gaps.description: middleware/auth.js: test the expired-session path. requireAuth should return 401 when session.expires_at < now(). Current statement coverage is 52.4%.
gaps.trigger: request with session token whose expires_at is in the past
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Expired session returns 401; row in sessions table is removed; coverage ≥ 90%

gaps.description: middleware/auth.js parseSessionCookie: test malformed cookie handling. The function is at 0% coverage per Istanbul (exported as parseSessionCookie? Actually function is local; needs coverage via calling code).
gaps.trigger: Cookie header with no 'session_token=' prefix, or empty value, or non-HTTP-safe chars
gaps.expected_result: parseSessionCookie returns null; request continues with optionalAuth or fails requireAuth
gaps.acceptance_criteria: All 3 malformed-cookie cases return null; coverage ≥ 90%

gaps.description: server.js WebSocket broadcast: test that broadcast() is called on exchange events. 67% statement coverage; the broadcast/broadcastOnEvent path is uncovered.
gaps.expected_result: WebSocket clients receive a 'bridge:new' event with the exchange payload
gaps.acceptance_criteria: ws client receives the broadcast within 1s; payload contains exchange_type, subject, content, status

gaps.description: server.js has its own parseSessionCookie function (duplicated from middleware/auth.js). This duplicate is at 0% coverage.
gaps.trigger: Refactor to use the middleware version, OR add coverage for the duplicate
gaps.acceptance_criteria: No duplicate function; one tested implementation; server.js statement coverage ≥ 90%

gaps.description: src/cli.js has 0% statement and 0% function coverage. The CLI is exercised by tests but Jest cannot collect coverage from spawned child processes.
gaps.trigger: Decision: refactor CLI to be importable as a module + test the parts directly, OR keep subprocess approach and accept low coverage
gaps.expected_result: Either CLI has > 80% statement coverage OR documented acceptance of low coverage with rationale
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Either (a) cli.js coverage ≥ 80% after refactor, or (b) ADR-002 documents why subprocess-only testing is the chosen strategy

gaps.description: context.js getContextHistory: 88.1% statement coverage; the history-retrieval path is not exercised by tests.
gaps.trigger: Set the same context key 3 times, then call getContextHistory(key)
gaps.expected_result: Returns array of 3 Context objects in chronological order
gaps.acceptance_criteria: History returns all versions in order; context.js coverage ≥ 95%

gaps.description: server.js XSS sanitization: tests/security.test.js exercises this but server.js coverage is 67% — the markdown sanitization code path in server.js may be untested directly (the security test may use a different path).
gaps.expected_result: Stored content has the script tag stripped/escaped (depending on policy)
gaps.acceptance_criteria: XSS payload does not appear in stored content; rendered HTML does not execute; server.js statement coverage ≥ 90%

gaps.description: Session expiration: the session table has expires_at but auth.js does not appear to check it on login validation. The middleware does, but if the login route accepts an expired session, that's a bug.
gaps.trigger: Login attempt with credentials whose existing session is expired
gaps.expected_result: Either re-auth succeeds and old session is invalidated, OR explicit 401 'session expired'
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Test asserts explicit behavior on expired session; coverage of auth.js ≥ 90%

gaps.description: db.js initializeDatabase: PRAGMA application (WAL mode, foreign_keys) is not testable via the public API directly. The 'if not exists' idempotency is also a concern.
gaps.trigger: Call initializeDatabase() twice on the same DB path
gaps.expected_result: No error; schema is unchanged; foreign_keys pragma still on
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Idempotent initialization passes; foreign_keys pragma verified via PRAGMA query

prioritization_rationale: P0 gaps are all T1 (auth surface) and represent direct security/correctness risk. P1 gaps are T1/T2 and impact user experience. P2 gaps are T2/T3 and are quality-of-life issues. The P3 backlog has no items because the project is well-tested overall (5 of 9 components at 100% behavioral coverage).
